items.headline: A 21-year-old just out-dueled Scottie Scheffler — Jackson Koivun wins the 3M Open
items.body: Storybook stuff in Minnesota. Jackson Koivun, 21 years old and in just his third start as a pro, closed out the 3M Open for his first PGA Tour title — and he did it by holding off world No. 1 Scottie Scheffler. Koivun posted a tournament-record 25-under 259 to win by three, while Scheffler fired a brilliant 64-63 on the weekend and still came up short, tipping his cap on the way to his fifth runner-up of the year.
items.say: A 21-year-old kid in basically his third pro tournament just beat Scottie Scheffler — the best golfer in the world — to win on the PGA Tour. Scheffler shot the lights out on the weekend and still lost. Wild breakthrough.

items.headline: Man City break the British record — £116m for Elliot Anderson
items.body: The transfer window just got its biggest number yet. Manchester City have signed midfielder Elliot Anderson from Nottingham Forest for a fixed £116 million — making the 23-year-old the most expensive British player ever, edging past the £115m Real Madrid paid for Jude Bellingham. Anderson was only unveiled this week because he'd been away winning a World Cup bronze medal with England, and he says he's exactly where he wants to be.
items.say: Manchester City just made Elliot Anderson the most expensive British footballer ever — £116 million, more than they paid for Bellingham. And he's an English kid who was playing for Nottingham Forest a year ago. The transfer window's gone completely mad.

items.headline: One week to the deadline — and the whole sport is watching Tarik Skubal
items.body: Baseball's trade deadline is Aug. 3, and the biggest domino is Tigers ace Tarik Skubal, the back-to-back AL Cy Young winner. Rival executives increasingly expect the Dodgers to swoop in — Bob Nightengale reports L.A. plans to 'be greedy,' chasing the first National League three-peat in history. Detroit's strong summer means they may just hold onto him, so the next week is going to be pure drama.
items.say: The baseball trade deadline is next Monday and everyone's watching one guy — Tarik Skubal, the best pitcher in the American League. The Dodgers are reportedly trying to grab him to chase a three-peat. If that trade happens, it's huge.

items.headline: A Romanian who started 30th just became FC World Champion
items.body: One for the football-gaming crowd: at the Esports World Cup in Paris, Romania's Razvan 'RvPLegend' Puiu won the EA Sports FC Pro World Championship — the sport's biggest FC 26 title — with a nerve-shredding 6-5 win over Germany's 'levyfinn' in the grand final. He'd entered the event ranked 30th in the world, banked $250,000, and rocketed all the way up to No. 4. Total dream run.
items.say: So the world championship of the FIFA/EA Sports FC video game just happened, and this guy from Romania who was ranked 30th won the whole thing 6-5 in the final. Came from nowhere and pocketed a quarter of a million. Love a good underdog story.

items.headline: Nolan's 'The Odyssey' just won the box office again
items.body: Christopher Nolan's epic 'The Odyssey' held onto the No. 1 spot in its second weekend, pulling an estimated $87 million in North America — a tiny ~30% drop that's excellent for a big movie. It's now past $286 million domestic and around $640 million worldwide. The star-stacked retelling of Homer (Matt Damon as Odysseus, plus Anne Hathaway, Tom Holland, Zendaya and Robert Pattinson) was shot entirely with new IMAX film cameras.
items.say: That new Christopher Nolan movie 'The Odyssey' won the box office for the second weekend in a row — it's already made like $640 million worldwide. Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Zendaya, the whole gang. Have you seen it yet?

items.headline: Emmy Rossum hunts a serial killer — 'Furious' premieres today
items.body: Buzzy new thriller alert: Hulu's 'Furious' drops its first three episodes today. Emmy Rossum plays an FBI agent locked onto a calculating female serial killer (Lola Petticrew), and the two women's lives start to blur the line between right and wrong. It's from 'New Girl' and 'The Dropout' creator Elizabeth Meriwether, with Jake Lacy and Scoot McNairy in the cast — eight episodes, one a week through Aug. 31.
items.say: There's a new Hulu thriller out today called 'Furious' — Emmy Rossum as an FBI agent chasing a female serial killer. It's from the woman who made 'New Girl' and 'The Dropout,' so it should be good. Might be my next binge.

items.headline: Shark Week is back — and it opens with K-pop shark heroes
items.body: The most gloriously silly week on TV returned Sunday: Discovery's Shark Week runs through Aug. 1 with 20 all-new specials a night. 'Air Jaws' is back, Josh Gates hosts an 'Ultimate Shark Dive,' and diver Molly Carlson attempts a record plunge into shark-filled water. The kickoff, 'K-Pop Shark Heroes,' teams Ken Jeong with artist REI AMI to give sharks a glow-up — an easy, fun thing to have on this week.
items.say: It's Shark Week — always good background chaos. This year they opened with a K-pop themed shark special with Ken Jeong, which is exactly as ridiculous as it sounds. You a Shark Week person?

items.headline: Morgan Wallen drops 'Been By Now' — after surprising a stadium with it live
items.body: Country's biggest name has a new one out. Morgan Wallen released 'Been By Now' on Friday, a breakup ballad about accepting a relationship has run its course, days after debuting it live to a sold-out Baltimore crowd who'd never heard it. It's the kind of easy, radio-ready Wallen track that tends to camp near the top of the charts for a while, so you'll be hearing it everywhere.
items.say: Morgan Wallen put out a new song, 'Been By Now' — he actually played it live in Baltimore before it dropped, which is a fun way to do it. It's a breakup song. You into any country?
